svg.title: Grant access produces two different kinds of access
svg.desc: Before saving, FoundryX checks the administrator's 15 subscription management Actions, ARM resource discovery permissions, and separate native Toolbox data access. Saving a new registration provisions Azure resource roles to the FoundryX service principal and separately saves project ACL entries for users, groups, or a tenant-wide audience. Employees receive FoundryX roles, not direct Azure RBAC grants.
svg.text: Grant access: administrator checks, then two separate grants
The permissions needed to grant access are not the project roles users receive.
BEFORE SAVE / SIGNED-IN ADMINISTRATOR
Check existing authority
All 15 subscription management Actions
+ ARM model and connection reads
+ native Foundry data access for Toolboxes
These checks grant no new permissions.
Choose project, models/tools, recipients,
and their FoundryX roles, then save.
See the guide for discovery failure recovery.
1 / AZURE SERVICE ACCESS
FoundryX service principal
Receives resource roles for the project,
parent account, and related resources.
Employees do not receive its credentials.
2 / FOUNDRYX USER ACCESS
Project ACL entries
Selected users, groups, or tenant audience
receive a FoundryX project role.
Consumer / User / Manager / Owner
Tenant-wide grants: Consumer or User only.
FoundryX checks each employee's project role and allowed models/tools before using service access.
An employee's FoundryX ACL does not grant direct native Foundry access or an Azure subscription role.
